era: Genesis / Game Gear / Master System platformer
summary: Treasure's surreal puppet-stage platformer, originally on Genesis/Mega Drive and later represented through 8-bit ports, compilations, and official emulation.

entries.title: Dynamite Headdy
entries.definitive_edition: Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box

emulation.emulator: PCSX2 for Treasure Box; Nintendo Switch Online or Genesis Plus GX for Genesis-only play
emulation.notes: Use PCSX2/PS2 for full version coverage; use Switch Online/PC Sega Classics only for the Genesis version.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: 16-bit originals inside the PS2 compilation; Genesis-only routes can be scaled/filter-emulated.

primary.version: Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box
primary.why: The Japanese PS2 Treasure Box is the most complete archival route because it includes all released versions of Dynamite Headdy across Genesis/Mega Drive, Game Gear, and Master System regions, including the original Japanese version and the harder localized versions.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box on PS2 or PCSX2 for full version coverage. If you only want the common Genesis game, Nintendo Switch Online or an owned PC Sega Classics copy is easier.

all_releases.fidelity: Original 16-bit release; western localization increased difficulty and changed/removes some dialogue/sprites.
all_releases.reason: skip: essential original platform, but the PS2 Treasure Box includes all regional versions.
skip: lower-fidelity port, included in the PS2 Treasure Box package.

all_releases.fidelity: Brazil-only Master System port based on the Game Gear version.
all_releases.reason: skip: lower-fidelity port, included in the PS2 Treasure Box package.

all_releases.fidelity: Sega Ages 2500: Gunstar Heroes Treasure Box compilation, including every released Dynamite Headdy version across platforms and regions.
all_releases.reason: primary: most complete official package for the franchise entry.
skip: official Genesis route, but not the full multi-version package.

all_releases.fidelity: Genesis/Mega Drive version included in later Sega compilations.
all_releases.reason: skip: convenient access, but not as complete as the PS2 Treasure Box.
skip: capture-friendly when owned, but not complete across platforms/regions and affected by Sega Classics delisting.

all_releases.fidelity: SEGA Genesis - Nintendo Switch Online subscription release, with Switch 2 compatibility marked supported.
all_releases.reason: skip: current official Genesis access route, but not the full multi-version package.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC/Switch Genesis routes are easier for capture, but the PS2 Treasure Box is the complete archive route with all platform/regional versions.

entries.remaster_caveats: The primary is a Japanese PS2 compilation rather than a modern remaster; Sega Classics/Steam routes are convenient if owned but were delisted for new purchase after December 2024.
